## Property Description

Offered is a 43 m² let one-bedroom flat in a prestigious, historic building dating from 1899.
 The flat is located on the top, 5th floor and has a living area of approx. 43 m². It has been completely renovated and fitted with a new central gas heating system. The flat also includes its own cellar compartment.
 The flat is let for 491 euros all-inclusive. Of this, 300 euros account for the basic rent and 191 euros for the service charges.

## Fittings

Cellar

The rear building (back house) is to be demolished. The demolition has already been approved; corresponding quotations are available. The special levies required for this have already been resolved and settled.

However, at the last owners' meeting it became known that, due to long-standing damp damage in the rear building, impairments have now also arisen in the front building. For this reason, additional renovation measures are now required for the staircases. Further special contributions are currently being levied for this purpose.

Whether further costs will arise cannot be guaranteed at this point in time. However, based on the current assessment, the measures already agreed should initially be sufficient.

## Location

The location in the centre of Wuppertal offers excellent infrastructure: public transport stops, various shopping facilities, banks, doctors' surgeries and everything needed for daily life are in the immediate vicinity.

Wuppertal is the largest city in the Bergisches Land region in the west of North Rhine-Westphalia. The city is regarded as the capital as well as the economic, industrial and cultural centre of the region. Known as the "big city in the countryside", Wuppertal lies south of the Ruhr area, in the geographical heart of the Rhine-Ruhr metropolitan region. Düsseldorf is only about 30 km away, Cologne about 40 km, and Essen about 23 km.

As a university city with around 354,000 inhabitants, Wuppertal is the seventh-largest city in North Rhine-Westphalia and ranks among the most significant cities in the state.

Effects of withdrawal

If you withdraw from this contract, we shall reimburse to you all payments received from you, including the costs of delivery (with the exception of the supplementary costs resulting from your choice of a type of delivery other than the least expensive type of standard delivery offered by us), without undue delay and in any event not later than fourteen days from the day on which we are informed about your decision to withdraw from this contract. If you requested to begin the performance of services during the withdrawal period, you shall pay us an amount which is in proportion to what has been provided until you have communicated to us your withdrawal from this contract, in comparison with the full coverage of the contract.
